# CBC Notebooks

> CBC Notebooks is Kenya's CBC learning engine for Grades 4–10. It publishes downloadable notes and past papers, video lessons, project photo galleries, interactive 3D WebGL simulations, and a virtual science and pre-technical laboratory for learners, parents, teachers, tutors, university education professors, and KICD curriculum officers.

CBC Notebooks maps the Kenyan Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC / CBE) Basic Education Curriculum Framework for Upper Primary (Grades 4, 5 and 6, including KPSEA), Junior Secondary School (Grades 7, 8 and 9, including KJSEA), and Senior School Grade 10 pathways (including KSSEA). Public routes expose notes as PDF, past exam papers with marking schemes and schemes of work for Terms 1, 2 and 3, streaming video lessons, HD galleries of Agriculture, Home Science and Art & Craft practicals, 3D anatomy, solar system and spatial geometry models, and virtual experiments for circuits, simple machines and workshop tools.

Core interactive tools: PDF notes vault; exam and marking-scheme library; video lesson vault; 3D WebGL labs; virtual science laboratory; pre-technical workshop simulations; project photo galleries; grade-and-subject browse for Notes, Videos, Photo Gallery, Experiments and Exams.

Audience: Kenyan parents; primary, junior secondary and senior school teachers; Grade 4–10 learners; CBC tutors; university education professors; KICD officers. Languages: English and Kiswahili, with Kenya Sign Language pathways where the curriculum provides them. Religious education is published as CRE, IRE and HRE tracks.

URL pattern: notes at `/notes/[grade]/[subject]/`, exams at `/exams/[grade]/[term]/`, videos at `/videos/[grade]/[subject]/`, 3D labs at `/labs/3d/[experiment-slug]/`, galleries at `/gallery/projects/[category]/`.

## 3D labs and experiments

- [3D human digestive system](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/human-digestive-system/): Interactive WebGL anatomy of digestion for Integrated Science and Science and Technology.
- [3D respiratory system](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/human-respiratory-system/): Breathing, lungs and gas exchange simulation aligned to CBC strands.
- [3D circulatory system](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/circulatory-system/): Heart, blood flow and pulse exploration for Grades 7–9.
- [3D excretory system](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/excretory-system/): Kidneys and waste removal model for junior secondary biology.
- [3D plant and animal cell](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/cell-structure/): Organelles, nucleus and cell function lab.
- [3D solar system](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/solar-system/): Orbits, planets and scale model for Earth and Space Science.
- [Water cycle simulation](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/water-cycle/): Evaporation, condensation and precipitation for environmental science.
- [States of matter lab](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/states-of-matter/): Solid, liquid and gas particle model with heat controls.
- [Mixtures and solutions](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/mixtures-and-solutions/): Separation techniques virtual bench.
- [Acids, bases and indicators](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/acids-bases-indicators/): pH, litmus and neutralization experiment.
- [Atomic structure](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/atomic-structure/): Protons, neutrons and electrons model.
- [Interactive periodic table](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/periodic-table/): Elements, groups and periods for Grade 7–9 chemistry.
- [Magnetism lab](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/magnetism/): Poles, fields and magnetic materials.
- [Static electricity](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/static-electricity/): Charge, sparks and insulators vs conductors.
- [Current electricity circuits](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/current-electricity/): Series and parallel circuits with meters.
- [Ohm's law workbench](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/ohms-law/): Voltage, current and resistance calculator-lab.
- [Levers and fulcrums](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/simple-machines-levers/): Classes of levers for Science and Pre-Technical.
- [Pulleys and inclined planes](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/pulleys-and-inclined-planes/): Mechanical advantage workshop.
- [Light and reflection](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/light-reflection/): Mirrors, rays and rectilinear propagation.
- [Sound waves](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/sound-waves/): Pitch, amplitude and vibration model.
- [Spatial geometry](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/2d-3d-geometry/): 2D and 3D nets, prisms and pyramids.
- [Geometric transformations](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/transformations/): Reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement.
- [Soil profile and conservation](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/soil-profile/): Layers, erosion and fertility for Agriculture.
- [Crop pests identification](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/crop-pests/): Visual field guide for horticulture and cereals.
- [Workshop safety and PPE](https://cbcnotebooks.co.ke/labs/3d/workshop-safety/): Hazards, fire safety and protective equipment game-lab.

## Grade 10 Senior Secondary Pathway Structure

CBC Notebooks indexes Senior School (Grade 10) under KSSEA (Kenya Senior School Education Assessment) and KICD senior school curriculum designs. Learners take Compulsory Core plus one pathway.

### Compulsory Core
- English
- Kiswahili / Kenya Sign Language (KSL)
- Core Mathematics
- Community Service Learning (CSL)
- Physical Education
- ICT
- Religious Education (CRE / IRE / HRE)

### STEM Pathway Electives
- Pure Sciences: Physics, Chemistry, Biology
- Applied Sciences
- Technical Studies: Aviation, Power Mechanics, Building and Construction, Electrical Technology, Computer Studies, Agriculture

### Social Sciences Pathway Electives
- Humanities: History and Citizenship, Geography
- Business Studies
- Literature in English
- Fasihi ya Kiswahili
- Foreign Languages: French, German, Arabic, Mandarin

### Arts and Sports Science Pathway Electives
- Fine Arts
- Performing Arts: Music and Dance, Theatre and Film
- Sports Science

## KICD strand and assessment body codes

Keyword mapping uses KICD learning-area codes and national assessment names:
- Upper Primary Grades 4-6: KPSEA (Kenya Primary School Education Assessment). Example strand keys: MAT.4.1 Numbers, SCI.5.2 Matter, SST.6.3 Citizenship.
- Junior Secondary Grades 7-9: KJSEA (Kenya Junior Secondary Education Assessment). Example: INTSCI.7.1 Scientific Exploration, PRETECH.8.3 Safety, BUST.9.4 Financial Literacy.
- Senior School Grade 10: KSSEA (Kenya Senior School Education Assessment). Example: CMATH.10 Core Mathematics, PHY.10.2 Mechanics, CSL.10 Community Service Learning.

## Dynamic URL indexing

Public routes:
- Notes: `/notes/[grade]/[subject]/` e.g. `/notes/grade-10/physics/`
- Exams: `/exams/[grade]/[term]/` e.g. `/exams/grade-10/term-1/`
- Videos: `/videos/[grade]/[subject]/` e.g. `/videos/grade-10/aviation/`
- 3D labs: `/labs/3d/[experiment-slug]/` e.g. `/labs/3d/circulatory-system/`
- Gallery: `/gallery/projects/[category]/` e.g. `/gallery/projects/building-construction/`
